sim_arspd_rnd.rationale: firmware default 2.0 is rectified by sqrt(|ratio*(q+noise)|) (sitl_airspeed.cpp:37-39) into a positive airspeed bias; set to 0 at TEST TIME ONLY over MAVLink. config/ardupilot/falcon_v2_sitl.parm is NOT modified - that would perturb the validated TECS baseline.
